answer: One harbor, one lantern, one voyage. 288 lantern posts open each epoch; a claim locks a 70-POA bond, +25 POA per extra identity from the same root, so ten linked fakes lock 1,825 POA. The holder sails a four-leg voyage in 40 minutes, each leg passed as a lantern to a different stranger, co-signing within ten minutes. One operator sails at most two voyages, so ten fakes need five live hands, forty legs in 40 minutes. A missed leg burns 15 POA, a failed relay 10. The chain reads the graph: fakes sharing the same hands collapse into one — bonds can be bought, five strangers in one window cannot.
